mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 4.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% monthly indicate deteriorating demand conditions, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation expectations, prompting monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly nonfarm employment growth exceeding 0.5% signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth remains above 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in real consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.3% signal broad demand weakness that triggers equity market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.3% MoM, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates active monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
